instruction: We're facing towards a console table and on top of the console table there are candles and behind it there's a mirror, take a few steps forward, on the left there are windows covered with grey curtains, on the right there's a round table above a round carpet, walk towards the right side of carpet... You're now facing towards a wide doorway that leads into a swimming pool area, in front of the doorway there are two small carpets, walk towards the carpet that's on the right, you'll be facing towards the swimming pool area, and you've arrived.
